triet-tieu-hang-tu.symptom: Triệt tiêu hạng tử qua dấu cộng/trừ thay vì nhân tử.

tru-khong-doi-dau-tu-thuc.symptom: Dấu trừ trước phân thức/ngoặc không đổi dấu toàn bộ tử thức.

qa_notes: KNTT Bài 21 includes value of a rational expression at an allowed variable value.
KNTT Bài 23 includes addition/subtraction of multiple rational expressions and use of addition properties / bracket rule.
KNTT Bài 24 includes multiplication properties in addition to multiplication/division rules.
Do not encode every pedagogical sequence as a causal Knowledge Graph prerequisite.
Learning-card skill IDs are aligned with the existing CĐ07 Practice Bank manifest.
Micro-practice IDs are stable authored items in RAT07-MICRO-V1; Extension never contributes to Core completion.
Card 1 includes hai-phan-thuc-bang-nhau as KNTT Core metadata even though the 3-item micro set samples only part of the card.
misconception_registry is descriptive only; review_context_only must never be treated as causal remediation without independent learner evidence + reviewed graph/rule.

observed_signal_policy.rule: Option-level misconception signals are observations, not diagnoses. A signal may guide local feedback/Tutor context but must not create causal remediation without sufficient learner evidence and a reviewed Knowledge Graph/rule.
observed_signal_policy.signal_weight: Optional 1–2 salience value for ranking/feedback only; never added to accuracy and never used alone to mark a skill weak.
